<script>
    var verifyCallback = function(token) {
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('grecaptchaVerified', {'detail': {response: token}}));
    };
    var expireCallback = function() {
        document.dispatchEvent(new Event('grecaptchaExpired'));
    };
    var errorCallback = function() {
        document.dispatchEvent(new Event('grecaptchaError'));
    };
   
    var recaptcha1;
    var myCallBack = function() {
    //Render the recaptcha1 on the element with ID "recaptcha1"
    recaptcha1 = grecaptcha.render('recaptcha1', {
    'sitekey': '6Lf_OeEZAAAAABDL6V3YPqhSWueDcNn4mSluJJyc',
    'lang' : 'fr'
   });};
    document.addEventListener('grecaptchaRender', function(e) {
        grecaptcha.render(e.detail.element, {
            'sitekey': '6Lf_OeEZAAAAABDL6V3YPqhSWueDcNn4mSluJJyc',
            'callback': verifyCallback,
            'expired-callback': expireCallback,
            'error-callback': errorCallback
        });
    });
    document.addEventListener('grecaptchaReset', function() {
        grecaptcha.reset();
    });
</script>

<!-- Dynamic Stylesheet Loading For Cache Refresh -->
<script>
    var versionKey = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    function addCss(fileName) {
        try{
            console.log('fileName ' + fileName);
            var head = document.head;
            var link = document.createElement("link");
            link.type = "text/css";
            link.rel = "stylesheet";
            link.href = fileName;
        } catch (error){
            console.error(error);
        }
        head.appendChild(link);
    }
    //Start Loading CSS
    addCss('https://ironmountain.my.site.com/irmeuropecommunity/s/sfsites/c/resource/CSC_PortalCSS/CSC_PortalSharedStyling.css?v={versionKey}');
    addCss('https://ironmountain.my.site.com/irmeuropecommunity/s/sfsites/c/resource/CSC_PortalCSS/myCasesPage.css?v={versionKey}');
    addCss('https://ironmountain.my.site.com/irmeuropecommunity/s/sfsites/c/resource/CSC_PortalCSS/caseDetailsPage.css?v={versionKey}');
    addCss('https://ironmountain.my.site.com/irmeuropecommunity/s/sfsites/c/resource/CSC_PortalCSS/dontSeeWhatYouAreLookingForCTA.css?v={versionKey}');
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
     // Utility functions for chatbot operations
    const checkPreChatFieldsValues = value => value !== undefined && value !== null;
    var sitelanguage = document.getElementsByTagName("html")[0].getAttribute("lang");
    var embeddedservicelanguage = '';
    // Set preChat Hidden fields
    function callPrechatAPI(event) {
        console.log('BrowserLanguage: ' + navigator.language);
        console.log(sitelanguage);
        var userDetails = {


            userId: $A.get('$SObjectType.CurrentUser.Id'),
            isExperience: 'True',
            language: sitelanguage
        };


        console.log('userDetails', userDetails);


        Object.entries(userDetails).forEach(([key, value]) => {
            console.log('Value:: ', checkPreChatFieldsValues(value));
            if (checkPreChatFieldsValues(value)) {
                console.log('Key: ' + key + ' Value: ' + value);
                embeddedservice_bootstrap.prechatAPI.setHiddenPrechatFields({ [key]: value });
            }
        });
    };
    window.addEventListener("onEmbeddedMessagingReady", callPrechatAPI);


    //Load ESD depending on authenticated user


    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const userAuthenticated = !!$A.get('$SObjectType.CurrentUser.Id') ? true : false;
        var config;
        if (userAuthenticated) {
            config = {
                bootstrapMinJs: 'https://ironmountain.my.site.com/ESWEnglishMessagingEmbe1722435646179/assets/js/bootstrap.min.js',
                eswConfigDevName: 'English_Messaging_Embedded_Service_Authenticated_User',
                orgId: '00D80000000aP47',
                scrt2URL: 'https://ironmountain.my.salesforce-scrt.com',
                siteURL: 'https://ironmountain.my.site.com/ESWEnglishMessagingEmbe1722435646179'
            };
        } else {
            config = {
                 bootstrapMinJs: 'https://ironmountain.my.site.com/ESWEnglishMessagingEmbe1717675729540/assets/js/bootstrap.min.js',
                eswConfigDevName: 'English_Messaging_Embedded_Service_Guest_User',
                orgId: '00D80000000aP47',
                scrt2URL: 'https://ironmountain.my.salesforce-scrt.com',
                siteURL: 'https://ironmountain.my.site.com/ESWEnglishMessagingEmbe1717675729540'
            };


        }
        console.log('config setting:: ' + JSON.stringify(config));
        if (sitelanguage == 'fr') {
            embeddedservicelanguage = 'fr'


        } else if (sitelanguage == 'de') {
            embeddedservicelanguage = 'de'
        }
        else if (sitelanguage == 'en-GB') {
            embeddedservicelanguage = 'en_GB'
        }
        else if (sitelanguage == 'es') {
            embeddedservicelanguage = 'es'
        }
        else if (sitelanguage == 'de-AT') {
            embeddedservicelanguage = 'de_AT'
        }

        function initEmbeddedMessaging() {
            try {
                embeddedservice_bootstrap.settings.language = embeddedservicelanguage; // For example, enter 'en' or 'en-US'
                embeddedservice_bootstrap.init(
                    config.orgId,
                    config.eswConfigDevName,
                    config.siteURL,
                    {
                        scrt2URL: config.scrt2URL
                    }
                );
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error loading Embedded Messaging: ', err);
            }
        };
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = config.bootstrapMinJs;
        script.onload = initEmbeddedMessaging;
        document.body.appendChild(script);


    });


    //Start chat on click on link and chat button  
    document.addEventListener("chatEvent", chatClickHandler, false);
    function chatClickHandler(event) {
        if (event.detail.startChat === true) {
            embeddedservice_bootstrap.utilAPI.launchChat()
                .then(() => {
                    console.log('Chat initiacted');
                    //disableLaunchChatButton();
                }).catch(() => {
                    console.log('Error initaiting chat');
                    //hideLaunchChatButton();
                }).finally(() => {
                    console.log('Do nothing');
                    //logEndUserAttemptToChat();
                });
        }
    }
</script>
